task_description: Integrate an interactive Nepal Bhasa & Nepali AI Chat Platform into the LipiAI frontend (TanStack Start / React 19 / Tailwind v4). Create chat-service.ts, chat-interface.tsx, and routes/chat.tsx; add Chat nav link to the shell; append chat CSS; add Ranjana @font-face; document env vars. Three chat modes: Nepal Bhasa Devanagari, Nepali Ranjana, Nepal Bhasa Ranjana. Ranjana is font-only rendering (same Unicode codepoints as Devanagari, displayed by RanjanaUNICODE1.0.ttf).
